title: Treasurer needs a new payment account
scenario: A club treasurer messages that the club’s bank account is temporarily frozen and asks members to send event payments to a personal account so the booking is not lost.

answers.A: Ask for the payment change to be posted in the club’s official channel with adviser approval.
answers.B: Pay because you know the treasurer personally and the event deadline is real.
answers.C: Verify the change with another officer/adviser and use the club’s approved payment process before sending money.

explanation: A known person can have a compromised account or make an unsafe shortcut. Organizational payment controls protect everyone.
proTip: Knowing the treasurer does not authenticate a new bank account.
